basic_info.description: Welcome to 901 Bush #303! Conveniently located in the heart of Nob Hill, this single-level condo offers easy access to the Financial District and Union Square, while being just blocks away from the vibrant Hyde Street shops. Set in a beautifully restored elevator building, it blends the charm of its elegant original facade and architectural details with modernized interiors and updated common areas. Tucked away at the back of the building, this quiet 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence features a thoughtfully designed open floor plan with high ceilings, newly refinished hardwood floors, fresh paint, and a modern kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and Caesarstone countertops with barstool seating. Additional amenities include an in-unit Bosch washer and dryer, a private storage unit with extra bike storage, and an expansive common roof deck - further enhancing the home's appeal.
